//TR: Bu checkpoint Founder yetkili çift yürütme dokusunu (LOCAL_CLAUDE + CLAUDE_CLOUD_SESSION backend registry'si, fail-closed yönlendirme, yürütme provenance'ı, merge kapısı) ve aynı commit'teki trust-root reseal'ini kaydeder; cloud dispatch yapılandırılmamıştır, cloud yürütmesi iddia edilmez ve merge ca21e83 release Phase0'ı tamamlanana kadar bekletilir.
founderRequest: Add CLAUDE_CLOUD_SESSION as a first-class execution backend in UASCO without replacing LOCAL_CLAUDE: backend registry, routing policy (task type, local availability and quota pressure when observable, cloud availability and credit availability when observable, host resources, filesystem/network boundaries, duration, security classification), cloud preferred for suitable long-running or parallel host-independent work, host-bound operations LOCAL_ONLY, private release-signing keys never in a cloud session, cloud work on isolated branches never mutating reviewed master, cloud output through deterministic validation -> evidence -> independent Codex review -> remediation/re-review -> merge gate, producer != reviewer, durable execution provenance, fail-closed fallback, no assumed API credits or invented billing API, routing modes AUTO/LOCAL_ONLY/CLOUD_PREFERRED/CLOUD_ONLY with AUTO default, observability only from exposed signals, regression tests, documentation, separate bounded package, canonical validation, commit, independent Codex review; do not weaken the trust model, do not make cloud mandatory, do not expose local credentials or signing keys.

founderAuthorization.rule: [Kapsam: 5 dosya, şemasız] Protected: config/execution-backends.json (yeni: backend kaydı, AUTO varsayılan mod, LOCAL_ONLY iş türleri, cloud'a yasak veri sınıfları, fallback politikası), automation/lib/execution-routing.mjs (yeni: fail-closed yönlendirme, provenance, merge kapısı), automation/factory-supervisor.mjs (builder'dan önce yönlendirme ve provenance kaydı), trust-root reseal, CANONICAL-STATUS.md. Provenance sözleşmesi kodda doğrulanır ve belgelenir; paste4c'deki 152 şema sayısı sabiti değişmez. Cloud dispatch belgelenmiş bir Claude yöntemi yapılandırılana kadar NOT_CONFIGURED kalır; asla taklit edilmez. [Sıra: Release'i bozma] Paket PKG-R3'ün üzerinde ayrı bir dalda uygulanır, doğrulanır, commit edilir ve PKG-R3'ten sonra Codex review'a girer; merge ca21e83 release'inin Phase0'ı bitene kadar bekletilir; zamanlanmış 02:05 görevi değişmez.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.

design.registry: config/execution-backends.json: LOCAL_CLAUDE (CONFIGURED via the existing builder broker) and CLAUDE_CLOUD_SESSION (NOT_CONFIGURED, adapter null, hostBoundCapable false, mayMutateDefaultBranch false, capacityModel PRODUCT_MANAGED_CAPACITY_NOT_API_CREDITS, billingApi NONE_ASSUMED); loadExecutionBackendRegistry rejects any registry that breaks a security invariant (only-modes without fallback, release signing founder-only, cloud-forbidden data classes, reviewer provider different from producers, producer may not review own output, merge requires CLEAN, all pipeline stages present, configured cloud dispatch needs an adapter).
design.routing: routeExecution is pure and deterministic: founder-only -> FOUNDER_ACTION_REQUIRED; host-bound (local-only type, host resource, forbidden data class, local credentials, non-worktree filesystem, classification above INTERNAL, unclassified type) -> LOCAL_CLAUDE or QUEUED in every mode; cloud-eligible -> mode rules with policy fallback; unknown availability is unavailable.
design.supervisor: The registry loads at start; before the builder the supervisor routes the package, writes evidence/<pkg>-execution-route.json, returns RETRY_WAIT for QUEUED, escalates any non-local decision (no cloud dispatcher exists), writes evidence/<pkg>-execution-provenance.json after the build, and runs assertExecutionMergeGate before both fast-forward merge paths (normal CLEAN and crash-safe resume), writing the final provenance.
design.observability: Local availability from PROVIDER_PROVENANCE; local quota pressure UNKNOWN unless supplied; cloud availability UNKNOWN/false and capacity UNKNOWN because no documented signal is exposed.
design.notChanged: LOCAL_CLAUDE execution path, builder policy, reviewer path, review governance, phase0 contract, schemas (count 152 unchanged).
